landing.title: FairShift
landing.subtitle: Fair work. Fair pay. Your voice.
landing.promiseHours: Every hour you work is recorded — overtime included.
landing.promisePay: A payslip you can read and hear, in your language.
landing.promiseVoice: Report danger or speak up safely, without your name.
landing.languageHint: You can change it any time.
landing.footer: Built for construction sites, hospitals, campuses and factories across India.
landing.how1: Scan the site QR to start your shift.
landing.how2: See every hour and rupee — and hear it read out loud.
landing.how3: Report danger by voice. Your name stays hidden.
landing.forWorkersText: Big buttons, voice and your own language. Works on any phone, even offline.
landing.forManagersText: One honest view of attendance, safety and pay, built on labour-law rules.

pay.title: Pay checked against your hours
pay.text: Spots unpaid overtime and shows the sum. Ask for a review in one tap.

danger.title: Report danger by voice
danger.text: Fire and other emergencies go straight to the top, with a call-112 button. Your name stays hidden.

help.title: Help when you need it
help.text: One-tap emergency and free helplines, plus clear next steps for your problem.

numbers.title: Speak up, safe in numbers
numbers.text: Management sees an issue only when 5 workers sign. Who signed is never stored.

welfare.title: Welfare you have earned
welfare.text: Counts the days a welfare board needs and gets you a signed work certificate.

passport.title: Skill passport
passport.text: Your verified work history and skills, shared by a QR link you control.

duty.title: Who is on duty now
duty.text: Live attendance, with fatigue alerts for long days and night shifts.

hazards.title: Hazards with deadlines
hazards.text: Every report has a deadline and moves up the chain if it is ignored.

payroll.title: Fair payroll
payroll.text: Overtime by labour law, and shortfalls flagged with the sum before workers have to ask.

risk.title: Early warning on quitting
risk.text: Quit risk for each worker with the reasons, and site conditions shown apart.

bank.title: Your pay account is safe
bank.text: If your bank account is changed, you are asked first. Say “not mine” and no pay goes there.

checkout.title: Pay everyone in one checkout
checkout.text: Tick who is owed, pay the total once, and each share goes to that worker’s own bank account. Nobody is paid twice.

t85.label: SDG 8.5
t85.text: Equal pay for work of equal value: every hour recorded, every rupee checked.

t88.label: SDG 8.8
t88.text: Labour rights and safe workplaces: danger reported, fixed on time, voices heard.

t810.label: SDG 8.10
t810.text: Access to banking: pay goes straight to each worker’s own bank account, and they are asked before any change is used.

help.intro: Free helplines, and quick advice for any problem at work.

help.disclaimer: Numbers are national helplines. 108 is the ambulance in most states; 112 works everywhere.

emergency: Get yourself and others to a safe place.
Call 112 now, or 101 for fire or 108 for an ambulance.
Tell your supervisor, then report it in FairShift.
safety: Stop work near the danger if you can do so safely.
Report it in FairShift: it goes to your supervisor with a deadline.
pay: Open your pay page: FairShift checks every hour against what was paid.
If it shows a gap, tap 'Ask for a review'.
For help with your rights, call the e-Shram helpline.
harassment: You are not to blame. If you are in danger, call 112.
The women's helpline 181 gives free, confidential help.
You can also speak up anonymously in FairShift.
health: Rest and drink water if you can.
Tele-MANAS (14416) gives free, private support any time.
If you feel unwell at work, tell your supervisor.
benefits: See which schemes you can get on your profile page.
Ask your employer for a work certificate there.
The e-Shram, EPFO and ESIC helplines can explain the details.
other: Write down what happened and when.
Speak up in FairShift: it is anonymous.
The e-Shram helpline can advise on your rights.
